北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴冷，体感 3℃，记得添衣保暖，多喝水哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and chilly, feels like 3℃. Stay warm and hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴冷，体感 7℃，出门别忘添衣，注意防寒哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and cool, feels like 7℃. Don't forget to dress warmly!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴冷，体感 7℃，多穿点，小心着凉，别感冒啦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and cool, feels like 7℃. Wear layers to avoid catching a cold!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州体感 27℃ 挺热的，湿度大，记得补充水分哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou feels warm at 27℃ with high humidity. Stay hydrated!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云暖和，湿度高，注意防潮，保持身体舒适。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is warm and partly cloudy with high humidity. Stay comfortable!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴冷潮湿，体感 6℃，注意保暖，别忘了带伞。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, cold, and humid, feels like 6℃. Dress warmly!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有霾，体感 10℃，出门记得戴口罩，注意健康。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has haze and feels like 10℃. Wear a mask when going out and take care!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 15℃，天气舒适，可以轻松出行。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and feels mild at 15℃. Enjoy the comfortable weather!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，体感 10℃，能见度低，出行请注意安全。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy and feels like 10℃. Visibility is low, please travel safely!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗干燥，体感 11℃，注意补水保湿，多喝水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is clear and dry, feels like 11℃. Stay hydrated and moisturize!
西安.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，体感 16℃，能见度不高，出行注意安全。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy and feels like 16℃. Visibility is low, please take care!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴冷，体感 -5℃，务必穿厚实，谨防冻伤。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is clear and very cold, feels like -5℃. Dress warmly to prevent frostbite!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感 -2℃，添衣保暖，别着凉，多喝水。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is partly cloudy and cold, feels like -2℃. Dress warmly and stay hydrated!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 17℃，风力较大，注意防风保暖。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and feels mild at 17℃. It's windy, so dress warmly against the wind!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 16℃，湿度较高，感觉会有些闷。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is partly cloudy and feels mild at 16℃, but high humidity might make it feel muggy.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴冷，体感 2℃，穿暖和点，小心海风着凉。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is clear and cold, feels like 2℃. Dress warmly, especially against the sea breeze!
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，体感 0℃，天气很冷，注意保暖防寒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is clear and cold, feels like 0℃. Be sure to dress warmly!
